title: Praecognita
summary: PRAECOG'NITA, noun plural [Latin before known.] Things previously known in order to understand something else. Thus a knowledge of the structure of the human body is one of the praeacognita of medical

inlines.v: PRAECOG'NITA, noun plural [Latin before known.] Things previously known in order to understand something else. Thus a knowledge of the structure of the human body is one of the praeacognita of medical science and skill.
